name: Gomamon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with the [Sea Beast] or [Shaman] trait or [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits and 1 card with the [TS] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon unsuspends, if you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
